e: Funds heliophysics investigations flown as research payloads on suborbital and airborne platforms, with a binding two-step submission and dual-anonymous review. NASA generally funds only US institutions; non-US groups may take part without exchange of funds.
f: NASA Science Mission Directorate, Heliophysics Division
n: NASA ROSES-2025 B.7 Heliophysics Low-Cost Access to Space (H-LCAS)
